Genesis Intel Hub — Privacy

Genesis Intel Hub is an independent public-source research website. We collect limited first-party usage analytics to understand readership, improve site navigation and identify broad research interests.

When enabled, our analytics record a temporary per-tab random session identifier, approximate country/region/city, network ASN/operator supplied by Cloudflare, browser and operating-system family, device category, referring website hostname, visited site sections and interactions such as article/project opens and searches. We record search result counts, not search text. We do not intentionally store raw IP addresses, names, email addresses, full user-agent strings or fingerprinting identifiers in our analytics database. Cloudflare may process request information independently to provide hosting and security.

Network operators and approximate locations are not reliable evidence of an individual's identity, employer or exact location. Our first-party session ID is stored in sessionStorage, not in a tracking cookie, and may persist until the browser tab or session closes. Events and sessions are retained for up to 90 days, subject to scheduled cleanup. Access to analytics reports is restricted to authorized administrators.

We do not sell visitor analytics data. Questions or privacy requests may be directed to the site operator using contact details provided through the site's official communication channels.
